_about: Stage 3 trend research. Each trend: where it was seen, a number, the day, and a decision. kind: hashtag | sound | format | meme | topic | creator | event | search. stage: rising | peak | fading | evergreen. decision: use | adapt | watch | avoid. method: observed (seen, with url and number) | inference (a guess, said as one).
observed_with: e.g. TikTok /search?q= and /tag/<tag> via browse (logged out), yt-dlp per video, X via web search

trends.metric: e.g. #12 in VN, +240% posts in 7 days

fit.how: exactly how a script uses it
